name: Balaam
summary: A man from Pethor whom Balak, king of Moab, called to curse Israel. God let him speak only blessings, but his advice later led Israel into sin.

key_moments.title: Told by God Not to Curse Israel
key_moments.description: Balak's elders came to Balaam at Pethor with payment to curse Israel. God told him not to go and not to curse the people, for they were blessed.

key_moments.title: Hears His Donkey Speak
key_moments.description: The angel of the LORD stood in Balaam's way with a drawn sword, and his donkey turned aside three times. When Balaam beat her, the LORD let the donkey speak, then opened Balaam's eyes to see the angel.

key_moments.title: Blesses Israel Instead of Cursing It
key_moments.description: Seeing that the LORD was pleased to bless Israel, Balaam looked out over their tents, and God's Spirit came upon him. He praised their tents and said whoever blessed Israel would be blessed.

key_moments.title: Killed in the War with Midian
key_moments.description: When Israel fought Midian, Balaam was killed with the sword. His advice had led Israel to sin against the LORD at Peor.
